verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only auto-import, merge, and categorization of bank transactions on the Pro plan. No reconciliation of a bank account against the ledger is documented, and nothing shows matched, unmatched, or duplicate transactions being surfaced for review. Auto-merge is an adjacent bank-feed behavior, not the reconciliation workflow this story asks for.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review
